name: Argentiferous-Holm
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, an orbital debris ring. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in platinum here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
